name: storytelleros
description: Skills and slash commands for StorytellerOS — write titles, build story bibles, run timers, capture tasks, log finance, manage your calendar, AND drive a connected WordPress site (posts, pages, shop products, media) from inside Claude Cowork. Pairs with the manually-added StorytellerOS connector at https://storytelleros.com/api/mcp. Social work hands off to the Author Automations Social plugin (no double-hop).
